title: Swarmhunters
description:
Features• A simple and casual action shooter: your weapons will automatically aim and shoot!

• Dash between bullets and kill your way out of numerous enemies!

• Four selectable characters, tens of unique weapons and upgrades!

• Non-static builds. You may play as you like on the battlefield!

• No need to unlock anything. Your knowledge is your best weapon!
description_short: Swarmhunters is a top-down arena action shooter. The war between human and bugs has become worse - Project Swarmhunters emerged at this situation. You play as the best space soldiers in the galaxy and your mission is to strike the hive and hunt down the Emperor, supreme commander of bugs.
